title: The Myth of Culturally Agnostic AI Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparative visual analysis of images generated by text-to-image models (Stable Diffusion and DALL·E 2) using culturally specific prompts (e.g., iconic artworks, historical figures) to evaluate the preservation of cultural associations, image regurgitation, and west-centric worldviews.
Visual comparison of model outputs using the prompt 'Songs of faith and devotion' to identify the presence of western-centric (Christian) versus eastern-centric religious iconography.
